scientific_integrity: All-dimensional statements have written proofs; finite-field enumerations in the checker corroborate five small instances and are not interpreted as universal certificates.
scientific_limitations: Finite-field theorem for all n>=3 and nonzero rank-one square-zero matrices only; does not cover higher-rank nilpotents or unrestricted full-matrix commuting graphs. Independent audit not performed. Equivalent prior treatment under alternative matrix-subspace terminology remains possible.
title: Maximal commuting cliques of rank-one square-zero matrices over finite fields
